title: TuckSecret
lead: TuckSecret resources the operator syncs from Tuck into Kubernetes Secrets. This page is read-only: create and change them with kubectl or GitOps. Secret values are never shown here.

metrics.pendingHint: not processed by the operator yet

truncated: Showing the first 5000 resources; the rest are hidden. Narrow the filter.

empty.title: No TuckSecrets yet
empty.text: There are no TuckSecret resources visible to you in the cluster. Create one with kubectl or GitOps and the operator will create the Kubernetes Secret.
empty.binding: The Tuck namespace comes from the tuck.io/tuck-namespace annotation on the Kubernetes Namespace. A token inside a Tuck namespace sees only the Kubernetes namespaces bound to it.

unavailable.title: Kubernetes API unavailable
unavailable.text: The Tuck server runs without access to the Kubernetes API (it needs --k8s-api and a ServiceAccount token). Deploy Tuck inside the cluster.

k8sForbidden.title: No permission to read TuckSecrets
k8sForbidden.text: The ServiceAccount of the Tuck server cannot list TuckSecrets and Namespaces. Enable the rule in the chart and upgrade the release.

k8sError.title: Could not read TuckSecrets
k8sError.message: The Tuck server could not get data from the Kubernetes API. See the server log for details.

forbidden.title: This list is not for you
forbidden.text: Viewing requires a policy with the list capability on sys/k8s/tucksecrets.

error.title: Could not load
error.message: The request to the Tuck server failed.

clusterDown: Some clusters could not be read: {{names}}. The rest is shown. Check the reviewer ServiceAccount token and that it may list tucksecrets and namespaces (deploy/server/external-cluster-rbac.yaml).
